title: Decoded compact QR onboarding invitation v1
description: Public, short-lived invitation decoded from the ag://q/ compact binary transport. It contains no authority or secret material.

nonce.description: Exactly 128 public random bits, unpadded base64url encoded.

issuedAt.description: ESP32 monotonic boot seconds at invitation generation; not a wall-clock timestamp.

expiresAt.description: ESP32 monotonic boot seconds at expiry; expiresAt-issuedAt is at most 300 seconds.
